# Offline regression tests

[English](README.md) | [日本語](../../../ja/test_case/offline/README.md) | [Français](../../../fr/test_case/offline/README.md) | [中文](../../../../test_case/offline/README.md)

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:localize; edit docs/i18n/translations.json. -->

Run `npm run verify` from the repository root to check types, documentation, and all `test_case/offline/**/*.test.ts`, in that order. Requires Node.js ≥22.19, Python 3, the pinned Pi submodule, and npm dependencies.

Current suites include runtime, audit, issue2, issue3, issue5, issue8, issue16, issue18, issue19, and issue20. #19 replaced the old issue4 recovery mechanism; applicable ownership regressions moved to issue19.

PostgreSQL scenarios register through [helpers/postgres.ts](../../../../test_case/offline/helpers/postgres.ts) and connect to a dedicated test service via `SECRETARY_TEST_DATABASE_URL`, creating a separate database per scenario. The role needs CREATEDB. Missing local configuration reports skip; CI requires actual execution.

Node reports pass/fail/skip/todo totals. AUD14’s Context-field semantics TODO is tracked by #24. Historical UI and load probes live in [historical/offline](../../../../test_case/historical/offline/README.md); old browser helpers in runtime/helpers require their original version.

See the [test guide](../../operations.md#development-checks) for targeted commands, database cleanup, and suite coverage.
